query:
SELECT id as "id!: String", 
name as "name!: String", 
name_is_locked as "name_is_locked!: bool", 
status as "status!: AccountStatus", 
addr as "addr!: Option < String >", 
created_at as "created_at!: UtcDateTime", 
updated_at as "updated_at!: Option < UtcDateTime >", 
claim_signature as "claim_signature!: Option < String >", 
claim_session_id as "claim_session_id!: Option < String >", 
processed_for_legacy_claim as "processed_for_legacy_claim!: bool", 
allows_gasless as "allows_gasless!: bool", 
acceptance_status as "acceptance_status!: AcceptanceStatus", 
invited_by_account_id as "invited_by_account_id!: Option < String >", 
invites_per_month as "invites_per_month!: i32", 
available_invites as "available_invites!: i32", 
invite_quota_last_replenished_at as "invite_quota_last_replenished_at!: UtcDateTime", 
lang as "lang!: super :: Lang", 
profile_pic as "profile_pic!: Option < String >", 
unclaimed_asami_balance as "unclaimed_asami_balance!: String", 
unclaimed_doc_balance as "unclaimed_doc_balance!: String", 
asami_balance as "asami_balance!: String", 
doc_balance as "doc_balance!: String", 
rbtc_balance as "rbtc_balance!: String", 
last_on_chain_sync as "last_on_chain_sync!: UtcDateTime", 
force_hydrate as "force_hydrate!: bool", 
total_collabs as "total_collabs!: i32", 
total_collab_rewards as "total_collab_rewards!: String", 
total_campaigns as "total_campaigns!: i32", 
total_collabs_received as "total_collabs_received!: i32", 
total_spent as "total_spent!: String" FROM accounts WHERE (NOT $1::boolean OR id = $2::varchar) AND (NOT $3::boolean OR id = ANY(CAST($4 as varchar[])) ) AND (NOT $5::boolean OR id <> ALL(CAST($6 as varchar[])) ) AND (NOT $7::boolean OR name = $8::varchar) AND (NOT $9::boolean OR name LIKE $10::varchar) AND (NOT $11::boolean OR name ILIKE $12::varchar) AND (NOT $13::boolean OR name_is_locked = $14::boolean) AND (NOT $15::boolean OR status = $16::account_status) AND (NOT $17::boolean OR status = ANY(CAST($18 as account_status[])) ) AND (NOT $19::boolean OR addr = $20::varchar) AND (NOT $21::boolean OR addr LIKE $22::varchar) AND (NOT $23::boolean OR addr ILIKE $24::varchar) AND ($25::boolean IS NULL OR (($25::boolean AND addr IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $25::boolean AND addr IS NULL))) AND (NOT $26::boolean OR created_at = $27::timestamptz) AND (NOT $28::boolean OR updated_at = $29::timestamptz) AND (NOT $30::boolean OR claim_signature = $31::varchar) AND (NOT $32::boolean OR claim_session_id = $33::varchar) AND (NOT $34::boolean OR processed_for_legacy_claim = $35::boolean) AND (NOT $36::boolean OR allows_gasless = $37::boolean) AND (NOT $38::boolean OR acceptance_status = $39::acceptance_status) AND (NOT $40::boolean OR acceptance_status = ANY(CAST($41 as acceptance_status[])) ) AND (NOT $42::boolean OR invited_by_account_id = $43::varchar) AND ($44::boolean IS NULL OR (($44::boolean AND invited_by_account_id IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT $44::boolean AND invited_by_account_id IS NULL))) AND (NOT $45::boolean OR invites_per_month = $46::int4) AND (NOT $47::boolean OR available_invites = $48::int4) AND (NOT $49::boolean OR invite_quota_last_replenished_at = $50::timestamptz) AND (NOT $51::boolean OR lang = $52::language) AND (NOT $53::boolean OR profile_pic = $54::text) AND (NOT $55::boolean OR unclaimed_asami_balance = $56::varchar) AND (NOT $57::boolean OR unclaimed_doc_balance = $58::varchar) AND (NOT $59::boolean OR asami_balance = $60::varchar) AND (NOT $61::boolean OR doc_balance = $62::varchar) AND (NOT $63::boolean OR rbtc_balance = $64::varchar) AND (NOT $65::boolean OR last_on_chain_sync = $66::timestamptz) AND (NOT $67::boolean OR last_on_chain_sync < $68::timestamptz) AND (NOT $69::boolean OR force_hydrate = $70::boolean) AND (NOT $71::boolean OR total_collabs = $72::int4) AND (NOT $73::boolean OR total_collab_rewards = $74::varchar) AND (NOT $75::boolean OR total_campaigns = $76::int4) AND (NOT $77::boolean OR total_collabs_received = $78::int4) AND (NOT $79::boolean OR total_spent = $80::varchar) ORDER BY 
      (CASE ($81 = 'Id' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'Id' AND $82) WHEN true THEN id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'Name' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN name ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'Name' AND $82) WHEN true THEN name ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'NameIsLocked' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN name_is_locked ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'NameIsLocked' AND $82) WHEN true THEN name_is_locked ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'Status' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'Status' AND $82) WHEN true THEN status ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'Addr' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN addr ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'Addr' AND $82) WHEN true THEN addr ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'CreatedAt' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'CreatedAt' AND $82) WHEN true THEN created_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'UpdatedAt' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN updated_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'UpdatedAt' AND $82) WHEN true THEN updated_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'ClaimSignature' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN claim_signature ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'ClaimSignature' AND $82) WHEN true THEN claim_signature ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'ClaimSessionId' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN claim_session_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'ClaimSessionId' AND $82) WHEN true THEN claim_session_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'ProcessedForLegacyClaim' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN processed_for_legacy_claim ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'ProcessedForLegacyClaim' AND $82) WHEN true THEN processed_for_legacy_claim ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'AllowsGasless' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN allows_gasless ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'AllowsGasless' AND $82) WHEN true THEN allows_gasless ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'AcceptanceStatus' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN acceptance_status ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'AcceptanceStatus' AND $82) WHEN true THEN acceptance_status ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'InvitedByAccountId' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN invited_by_account_id ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'InvitedByAccountId' AND $82) WHEN true THEN invited_by_account_id ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'InvitesPerMonth' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN invites_per_month ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'InvitesPerMonth' AND $82) WHEN true THEN invites_per_month ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'AvailableInvites' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN available_invites ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'AvailableInvites' AND $82) WHEN true THEN available_invites ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'InviteQuotaLastReplenishedAt' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN invite_quota_last_replenished_at ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'InviteQuotaLastReplenishedAt' AND $82) WHEN true THEN invite_quota_last_replenished_at ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'Lang' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN lang ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'Lang' AND $82) WHEN true THEN lang ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'ProfilePic' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN profile_pic ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'ProfilePic' AND $82) WHEN true THEN profile_pic ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'UnclaimedAsamiBalance' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN unclaimed_asami_balance ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'UnclaimedAsamiBalance' AND $82) WHEN true THEN unclaimed_asami_balance ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'UnclaimedDocBalance' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN unclaimed_doc_balance ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'UnclaimedDocBalance' AND $82) WHEN true THEN unclaimed_doc_balance ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'AsamiBalance' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN asami_balance ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'AsamiBalance' AND $82) WHEN true THEN asami_balance ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'DocBalance' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN doc_balance ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'DocBalance' AND $82) WHEN true THEN doc_balance ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'RbtcBalance' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN rbtc_balance ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'RbtcBalance' AND $82) WHEN true THEN rbtc_balance ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'LastOnChainSync' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN last_on_chain_sync ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'LastOnChainSync' AND $82) WHEN true THEN last_on_chain_sync ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'ForceHydrate' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN force_hydrate ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'ForceHydrate' AND $82) WHEN true THEN force_hydrate ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCollabs' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN total_collabs ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCollabs' AND $82) WHEN true THEN total_collabs ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCollabRewards' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN total_collab_rewards ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCollabRewards' AND $82) WHEN true THEN total_collab_rewards ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCampaigns' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN total_campaigns ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCampaigns' AND $82) WHEN true THEN total_campaigns ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCollabsReceived' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN total_collabs_received ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalCollabsReceived' AND $82) WHEN true THEN total_collabs_received ELSE NULL END) DESC
    ,
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalSpent' AND NOT $82) WHEN true THEN total_spent ELSE NULL END),
      (CASE ($81 = 'TotalSpent' AND $82) WHEN true THEN total_spent ELSE NULL END) DESC
     LIMIT $83 OFFSET $84
